<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#070b18">
<title>PLUMFALL · 매화전기 | 3D 장풍 액션</title>
<style>
:root{--gold:#e2c48c;--rose:#ff668d;--muted:#9daabc;--glass:#090f20cc;--line:#ffffff22;--action:#ff668d;font-family:Inter,Pretendard,"Apple SD Gothic Neo",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;background:#080c16;color:#f4f0ec}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--rose);outline-offset:3px}#game{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100vw;height:100dvh;display:block;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair;background:#0c1324}#game:active{cursor:crosshair}
#vignette{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,transparent 20%,#03071199 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#0509148a 0%,transparent 23%,transparent 72%,#040814bd 100%);z-index:1}#haze{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0a112ac9 0%,transparent 22%,transparent 75%,#0a112a9c 100%);opacity:.43}
#flash{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#ffffff77,transparent 65%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .16s}#hurt{pointer-events:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:20;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,transparent 35%,#f72b5aaa 100%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .28s}
#hud{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;display:none}.hud-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#101a2de0,#08101ed3);border:1px solid #c9d8e52b;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0006;backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}.topbar{position:absolute;left:22px;right:22px;top:17px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.logo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;white-space:nowrap}.logo strong{font-size:23px;font-family:Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:750;line-height:1.15}.logo small{letter-spacing:.24em;font-size:9px;color:#d5b88b}.tiny-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#b4c1d3}
.hud-level{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:250px;max-width:500px;flex:1;align-items:center;margin-top:4px}.level-badge{font-size:10px;color:#e8dcba;letter-spacing:.28em;font-weight:700}.level-line{height:5px;width:min(100%,370px);background:#44516f77;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 0 13px #070e1e}.level-line span{display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8d577e,#ff91a7,#ffe0ad);height:100%;width:0%;transition:width .35s}.level-count{font-size:10px;color:#a7b4ca;letter-spacing:.13em}
.topright{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}.top-stats{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#d1d8e1;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;margin-top:7px;white-space:nowrap}.top-stats b{color:#f5d49e;font-size:15px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.iconbtn{pointer-events:auto;border:1px solid #b2c5d238;background:#111a30bf;color:#f1edf4;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;font-size:18px;display:grid;place-items:center;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);transition:background .16s}.iconbtn:hover{background:#38425a}
.left-info{position:absolute;left:24px;top:112px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;width:216px}.hero-box{border-left:2px solid var(--action);padding:13px 14px;max-width:216px}.hero-title{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif KR',serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin-top:4px}.hero-sub{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#b8a5ad;margin-top:3px}.health-outer{height:10px;border-radius:10px;background:#273046;overflow:hidden;margin-top:14px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 6px #0009}.health-outer span{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b93461,#ed667e,#ffb58a);transition:width .2s}.bar-numbers{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:10px;color:#c3cbda;margin-top:7px}.skill-tip{color:#c1cad8;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;padding:11px 13px}.skill-tip b{color:#ffd0e0}.key{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid #ffffff44;border-radius:5px;padding:1px 6px;font:11px monospace;background:#1d2b40aa;color:#fff}
.combo-box{position:absolute;right:26px;top:114px;text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;align-items:flex-end}.combo-title{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.25em;color:#ffa9c5}.combo-num{font:900 50px/1 Georgia,serif;text-shadow:0 4px 25px #fd519a88;transition:transform .2s}.combo-text{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#d8ccd3}.combo-box.hide{opacity:.25}.bossbar{position:absolute;left:50%;top:96px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(440px,65vw);display:none;text-align:center}.bossbar strong{font:700 15px Georgia,'Noto Serif KR',serif;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#ffbc8e}.boss-track{height:13px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #ffb4785c;background:#161b31;margin-top:7px;overflow:hidden}.boss-track span{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#971a38,#ed5c52,#ffb44e);transition:width .2s}.bossphase{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.17em;color:#f0b69b;margin-top:4px}
#crosshair{position:fixed;left:50%;top:50%;width:40px;height:40px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;z-index:9;opacity:0;transition:opacity .1s}#crosshair:before,#crosshair:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:9px;border:1px solid #fff9;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 15px #ff97bf55}#crosshair:after{inset:16px;background:#fff;border:none;box-shadow:0 0 13px white}.cross-tick{position:absolute;background:#fce6f1;box-shadow:0 0 8px #ff82ae}.cross-tick.a{left:19px;top:-1px;width:2px;height:9px}.cross-tick.b{left:19px;bottom:-1px;width:2px;height:9px}.cross-tick.c{top:19px;left:-1px;width:9px;height:2px}.cross-tick.d{top:19px;right:-1px;width:9px;height:2px}#crosshair.lock:before{border-color:#ffcc75;box-shadow:0 0 20px #ffbf77b4}#crosshair.head:before{border-color:#ff5e8a;border-width:2px}#crosshair.charge{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.23)}#crosshair.fired{animation:crossshot .24s ease-out}@keyframes crossshot{0%{scale:1.8}100%{scale:1}}
#floating{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:11;overflow:hidden}.floatnum{position:absolute;font-weight:900;font-size:23px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.01em;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #000,0 0 18px #ffa0b8;animation:floatup .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.18,1) forwards;white-space:nowrap}.floatnum.crit{color:#ffe09a;font-size:30px}.floatnum.bad{color:#ff9caa}.floatnum.heal{color:#b6ffd6}@keyframes floatup{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,3px) scale(.75)}25%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-15px) scale(1.19)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-72px) scale(1)}}
#toast{position:absolute;left:50%;top:25%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif KR',serif;letter-spacing:.17em;font-size:19px;text-shadow:0 2px 20px #000;color:#fff6e7;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}.bottomui{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:flex;align-items:end;gap:11px}.skill{pointer-events:auto;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:82px;height:78px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#18263cd9,#0d1525ef);border:1px solid #b5c2d33e;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 7px 35px #0007;backdrop-filter:blur(14px);color:#e8e7e8;transition:transform .12s,border-color .12s}.skill:hover{border-color:var(--action);transform:translateY(-3px)}.skill.on{border-color:var(--action);box-shadow:0 0 28px #ff5f874c,inset 0 0 15px #ff5f872a}.skill .sig{font-size:25px;line-height:1}.skill strong{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}.skill .hotkey{position:absolute;right:6px;top:5px;font-size:9px;color:#c3aab1}.skill .cd-mask{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#020a1dcc;border-radius:13px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:800 19px Georgia}.skill.disabled .cd-mask{display:flex}.ultimate{width:95px;height:95px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #e5ac73;margin-left:13px;box-shadow:0 0 27px #ff9f4d45,inset 0 0 24px #ffad6050}.ultimate .cd-mask{border-radius:50%}.ultimate .sig{font-size:31px}.ultimate:not(.ready){opacity:.7}.ult-percent{position:absolute;bottom:8px;color:#f4cda2;font:700 10px monospace}
.dodgebar{pointer-events:auto;position:absolute;right:22px;bottom:31px;display:flex;gap:7px}.dodgebtn{width:49px;height:49px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ffffff55;background:#1f2b47ba;color:#eee;font-size:23px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #0007}.dodgebtn:active{background:#b8506b;transform:scale(.95)}.bottomhint{position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:22px;color:#9fabbe;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}.firetip{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:131px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:11px;color:#bac4d4;letter-spacing:.1em;text-shadow:0 1px 8px #000}
#menu,#intermission,#end,#pause,#loading,#error{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#050917d9;backdrop-filter:blur(15px);overflow:auto}#menu{display:flex;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 37%,#43344866,transparent 52%),linear-gradient(110deg,#080d1ce9,#090e1ad9)}.menu-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#080c1df2 0%,#0b101ec7 45%,#0c0c1a30 100%),url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:cover;background-position:60% 38%;opacity:.95;filter:saturate(.95)}.menu-content{position:relative;width:min(1200px,100%);max-height:100dvh;overflow-y:auto;padding:52px 55px;z-index:1}.eyebrow{color:#ddbe94;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;font-weight:800}.menu-heading{font:600 clamp(52px,6.8vw,100px)/1.05 Georgia,'Noto Serif KR',serif;letter-spacing:.035em;margin:16px 0 9px;text-shadow:0 5px 30px #060814}.menu-sub{font-size:13px;color:#d7c5bf;letter-spacing:.18em;margin-top:12px}.menu-desc{max-width:565px;color:#bec6d1;line-height:1.85;font-size:14px;margin:25px 0 27px;text-shadow:0 1px 5px #000}.select-title{font-size:10px;color:#f2c99c;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:13px}.roster{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:25px}.roster-item{position:relative;width:126px;height:144px;border:1px solid #8d9ab54a;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;background:#152036dd;text-align:left;color:#fff;padding:0;box-shadow:0 5px 30px #0006;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s}.roster-item:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#ffd2a4}.roster-item.active{border-color:#ff8b9e;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ff8b9e,0 0 26px #ff608b3b}.roster-item img{width:100%;height:103px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 23%;display:block;mask-image:linear-gradient(black 65%,transparent)}.roster-item .roster-name{position:absolute;bottom:20px;left:9px;right:0;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.roster-item small{position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:9px;color:#a6acc0;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.03em}.roster-item .selected-flag{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;font-size:10px;background:#ff6e90;color:white;padding:3px 5px;border-radius:4px;display:none}.roster-item.active .selected-flag{display:block}
.primarybtn{pointer-events:auto;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ec6683,#fd987b);color:#210d1a;border:none;border-radius:10px;padding:17px 35px;font-weight:900;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.12em;box-shadow:0 8px 40px #ea537b50;transition:transform .16s,filter .16s}.primarybtn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.13)}.primarybtn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ghostbtn{pointer-events:auto;border:1px solid #ffffff56;background:#192439a6;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:10px;color:#eff2fb;font-weight:700}.ghostbtn:hover{background:#344565}.menu-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}.menu-foot p{color:#b5bacb;font-size:10px;line-height:1.65;max-width:250px}.goldrule{width:115px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#edbc84,transparent);margin:21px 0}.menu-corner{position:absolute;right:32px;bottom:25px;color:#b2a1a7;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:9px}
.dialog{width:min(560px,calc(100% - 32px));background:linear-gradient(145deg,#172039f8,#0a1021fa);border:1px solid #e6bd9147;box-shadow:0 35px 100px #000c;border-radius:19px;padding:37px;text-align:center;position:relative}.dialog:before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:17%;right:17%;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ffc68f,transparent)}.dialog h2{font:600 36px Georgia,'Noto Serif KR',serif;margin:10px 0 12px;color:#f8e1c7}.dialog p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#b3c2d2}.dialog .eyebrow{font-size:9px}.choice-row{display:flex;gap:11px;margin-top:26px}.choice{pointer-events:auto;flex:1;min-width:0;border:1px solid #aab7c34a;background:#1d2b43bb;border-radius:11px;padding:17px 8px;color:#fff;transition:transform .12s,border-color .12s}.choice:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#ffcc9c}.choice:disabled{opacity:.32;cursor:not-allowed}.choice.selected{border-color:#f39d8d;background:#34304a}.choice .coicon{display:block;font-size:28px;margin-bottom:10px}.choice strong{display:block;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:9px}.choice span{display:block;color:#bbc6d6;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4}.choice b{display:block;color:#ffd18d;font-size:12px;margin-top:9px}.dialog-actions{margin-top:24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px}.endstats{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:20px 0}.endstats div{border:1px solid #ffffff26;background:#ffffff08;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 15px;min-width:95px}.endstats strong{display:block;font:800 23px Georgia;color:#ffdbae}.endstats small{color:#afbdd0;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.09em}
#loading{display:none;z-index:40;background:#070d1b}#loading .dialog{border:none;background:none;box-shadow:none}#loadtrack{height:5px;border-radius:6px;background:#27334a;margin:25px auto 9px;max-width:320px;overflow:hidden}#loadtrack span{display:block;height:100%;width:1%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b04a79,#fbc58d);transition:width .2s}#loadtxt{font:10px monospace;color:#b6bfd1}#error{z-index:50}#error p{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:900px){.menu-content{padding:28px 25px}.menu-heading{font-size:62px}.menu-desc{max-width:430px}.topbar{left:14px;right:14px;top:12px}.logo strong{font-size:17px}.top-stats{gap:6px;font-size:10px}.top-stats b{font-size:12px}.hud-level{min-width:100px}.left-info{left:12px;top:83px;width:165px}.hero-box{padding:10px}.hero-title{font-size:16px}.skill-tip{display:none}.combo-box{top:87px;right:12px}.combo-num{font-size:36px}.bottomui{bottom:15px;gap:6px}.skill{min-width:62px;height:65px}.skill .sig{font-size:20px}.skill strong{font-size:9px}.ultimate{height:78px;width:78px;margin-left:6px}.dodgebar{right:10px;bottom:15px}.dodgebtn{width:41px;height:41px}.firetip{bottom:105px}.bossbar{top:76px}}@media(max-width:570px){.menu-bg{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#090d1ef5 0%,#090d1cd5 85%),url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-position:70% center}.menu-content{padding:28px 17px}.menu-heading{font-size:clamp(48px,15vw,72px)}.menu-desc{font-size:12px;margin:15px 0}.roster{gap:8px}.roster-item{width:calc(25% - 6px);height:126px}.roster-item img{height:91px}.roster-item .roster-name{font-size:10px;bottom:17px;left:4px}.roster-item small{font-size:7px;left:4px}.menu-foot{gap:10px}.primarybtn{padding:15px 21px}.menu-foot p{font-size:9px}.logo strong{font-size:14px}.logo small{font-size:7px}.top-stats{gap:5px;margin-top:0;flex-direction:column;align-items:end}.top-stats b{font-size:11px}.hud-level{min-width:0;flex:1}.level-badge{font-size:8px}.level-count{font-size:8px}.iconbtn{width:30px;height:30px;font-size:16px}.topright{gap:5px}.left-info{top:78px}.hero-box{max-width:132px}.hero-title{font-size:14px}.hero-sub{font-size:8px}.combo-box{top:79px}.combo-num{font-size:32px}.combo-title{font-size:8px}.combo-text{font-size:8px}.bottomhint{display:none}.bottomui{left:12px;transform:none;bottom:10px;gap:5px}.skill{min-width:57px;width:57px;height:61px}.ultimate{height:70px;width:70px}.skill strong{font-size:8px}.dodgebar{right:9px;bottom:11px;flex-direction:column}.dodgebtn{width:38px;height:38px;font-size:18px}.firetip{bottom:99px;font-size:9px}.dialog{padding:24px 16px}.dialog h2{font-size:29px}.choice-row{gap:6px}.choice{padding:12px 5px}.choice strong{font-size:10px}.choice span{font-size:9px}}@media(max-height:580px){.menu-content{padding-top:15px;padding-bottom:15px}.menu-heading{font-size:50px}.menu-desc{margin:10px 0}.roster-item{height:110px}.roster-item img{height:78px}.bottomui{bottom:6px}}
#enemyLabels{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;overflow:hidden}.enemylabel{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;min-width:75px;gap:4px;will-change:transform;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 5px #03050dd0)}.etxt{background:#0a1020c4;color:#eae6ee;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:700;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:3px}.ehp{display:block;width:67px;height:4px;background:#192333d8;border:1px solid #ffffff26;overflow:hidden}.ehp i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d24c7a,#ffcb86);transition:width .14s}.enemylabel.threat .etxt{color:#ffd68a;border:1px solid #ff9a4b66}
</style></head><body>
<canvas id="game" aria-label="WebGL 3D action game"></canvas><div id="vignette"></div><div id="haze"></div><div id="flash"></div><div id="hurt"></div><div id="floating"></div><div id="enemyLabels"></div>
<div id="crosshair"><i class="cross-tick a"></i><i class="cross-tick b"></i><i class="cross-tick c"></i><i class="cross-tick d"></i></div>
<main id="hud" aria-label="게임 화면"><div class="topbar"><div class="logo"><strong>PLUMFALL</strong><small>매화전기 · CHI STRIKE</small></div><div class="hud-level"><div class="level-badge" id="stageLabel">ACT 01 · 매화령</div><div class="level-line"><span id="progress"></span></div><div class="level-count" id="waveLabel">WAVE 01 · 03 ENEMIES</div></div><div class="topright"><div class="top-stats"><span>✦ <b id="coins">0</b></span><span>점수 <b id="score">0</b></span></div><button class="iconbtn" id="muteBtn" title="효과음">♫</button><button class="iconbtn" id="pauseBtn" title="일시정지">Ⅱ</button></div></div>
<div class="left-info"><div class="hero-box hud-panel"><div class="tiny-label">CURRENT HERO / <span id="heroNum">01</span></div><div class="hero-title" id="heroName">매화검수</div><div class="hero-sub" id="heroSub">CRIMSON CHI</div><div class="health-outer"><span id="hpbar"></span></div><div class="bar-numbers"><span>생명력</span><b id="hptext">100 / 100</b></div></div><div class="skill-tip hud-panel"><b>조준</b> 마우스 이동 / 터치 드래그<br><b>발사</b> 클릭 / 손가락 떼기<br><b>기 모으기</b> 길게 누르기<br><b>회피</b> A · D / ← · →<br><b>기술</b> 1 · 2 · 3 / <b>궁극기</b> SPACE</div></div>
<div class="combo-box hide" id="comboBox"><div class="combo-title">KILL STREAK</div><div class="combo-num" id="comboNum">× 0</div><div class="combo-text" id="comboText">완벽한 일격</div></div>
<div class="bossbar" id="bossBar"><strong>봉황군주 · 불멸의 화신</strong><div class="boss-track"><span id="bossHP"></span></div><div class="bossphase" id="bossPhase">PHASE I / THE AWAKENING</div></div>
<div id="toast"></div><div class="firetip" id="fireTip">드래그해서 조준하고 놓으면 발사</div>
<div class="bottomui"><button class="skill on" id="skill0"><span class="hotkey">1</span><span class="sig">✦</span><strong>매화탄</strong><span class="cd-mask"></span></button><button class="skill" id="skill1"><span class="hotkey">2</span><span class="sig">❀</span><strong>연화폭</strong><span class="cd-mask"></span></button><button class="skill" id="skill2"><span class="hotkey">3</span><span class="sig">❄</span><strong>빙결진</strong><span class="cd-mask"></span></button><button class="skill ultimate" id="ultBtn"><span class="hotkey">SPACE</span><span class="sig">✹</span><strong>만개</strong><span class="ult-percent" id="ultPct">0%</span><span class="cd-mask"></span></button></div>
<div class="dodgebar"><button class="dodgebtn" id="dodgeL" aria-label="왼쪽 회피">‹</button><button class="dodgebtn" id="dodgeR" aria-label="오른쪽 회피">›</button></div><div class="bottomhint">WEBGL 2 · ORIGINAL 3D MODELS · BUILD 01</div>
</main>
<section id="menu"><div class="menu-bg"></div><div class="menu-content"><div class="eyebrow">ORIGINAL 3D WUXIA ACTION · PLAYABLE PROTOTYPE</div><h1 class="menu-heading">PLUMFALL</h1><div class="menu-sub">매화전기 <span style="color:#f1a8a1">✦</span> 장풍으로 전장을 가르다</div><div class="goldrule"></div><p class="menu-desc">조준하고, 기를 모아 발사하라. 약점을 노리면 강력한 일격. 몰려오는 무림의 적을 격퇴하고, 끝에서 기다리는 봉황군주에 도전해보자.</p><div class="select-title">01 / 캐릭터 선택</div><div class="roster" id="roster"><button class="roster-item active" data-hero="0"><span class="selected-flag">선택</span><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="매화검수 3D"><div class="roster-name">매화검수</div><small>연속 명중 · 균형형</small></button><button class="roster-item" data-hero="1"><span class="selected-flag">선택</span><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="빙월검희 3D"><div class="roster-name">빙월검희</div><small>빙결 · 정밀 사격</small></button><button class="roster-item" data-hero="2"><span class="selected-flag">선택</span><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="산악수호자 3D"><div class="roster-name">산악수호자</div><small>중장갑 · 충격파</small></button><button class="roster-item" data-hero="3"><span class="selected-flag">선택</span><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="암영살수 3D"><div class="roster-name">암영살수</div><small>속사 · 연쇄 타격</small></button></div><div class="menu-foot"><button id="startBtn" class="primarybtn">전투 시작하기　→</button><p>PC 마우스 / 모바일 터치 지원<br>기 모으기 · 헤드샷 · 장풍 스킬 · 보스전</p></div><div class="menu-corner">PLUMFALL / REAL-TIME WEBGL 2 · VERSION 0.1</div></div></section>
